A **Planning Backup** is the process of updating a state-action value estimate (Q-value) using simulated or "hallucinated" experiences generated by an internal world model, rather than real-world transitions.

## Key Distinction

* **Direct RL Update:** Uses actual reward and next-state feedback received from taking an action in the real environment.

* **Planning Backup:** Uses a simulated reward and next-state generated by querying an internal simulator.

In the context of [[Dyna-Q]], a planning backup is the exact mathematical operation performed during **Step 3B (Simulated Update)**. Every time the agent runs a Q-learning calculation on a simulated transition, it performs one planning backup.
